t: You're looking at a statue of John Henry Newman, the English cardinal, theologian and poet, standing outside Brompton Oratory. Newman was an important figure in the religious history of nineteenth-century England, and he was also an academic, philosopher, historian and writer. That makes this a fitting spot for him, outside an Oratory church. The sculptor was the French artist Léon-Joseph Chavalliaud. Take a moment to look at the figure itself, and then at the church behind it.
